key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often memory and swap statistics are updated.

key.name: show-hud
key.description: Whether the topmost floating HUD overlay is visible on the screen.

key.name: show-swap-in-panel
key.summary: Show Swap usage in top panel
key.description: Whether Swap usage and percentage should also be displayed in the GNOME top bar.

key.name: hud-position
key.description: One of: top-start, top-center, top-end, right-center, bottom-end, bottom-center, bottom-start, left-center.

key.name: click-through
key.description: When enabled, mouse clicks pass through the floating HUD to windows underneath.

key.name: hud-margin
key.description: Distance in pixels from the screen edge for the floating HUD.
